content: धारणा .²1 The act of holding, bearing, supporting, preserving, <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The faculty of retaining in the mind, a good or retentive memory; धीर्धारणावती मेधा <ls>Ak.</ls> .²3 Memory in general. .²4 Keeping the mind collected, holding the breath suspended, steady abstraction of mind; परिचेतुमुपांशु धारणाम् <ls>R. 8. 18</ls>; <ls>Ms. 6. 72</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 201</ls> (धारणेत्युच्यते चेयं धार्यते यन्मनो तया). .²5 Fortitude, firmness, steadiness. .²6 A fixed precept or injunction, a settled rule, conclusion; इति धर्मस्य धारणा <ls>Ms. 8. 184</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 38</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 124</ls>. .²7 Understanding, intellect; <ls>Y. 3. 73</ls>. .²8 Continuance in rectitude, propriety, decorum. .²9 Conviction or abstraction. .²10 A kind of योगाङ्ग; देशबन्धश्चित्तस्य धारणा <ls>Yogadarśana.</ls>
